caption: The drawing depicts a single metallic object composed of three main parts: a rectangular tray at the bottom, a cylindrical vertical support rising from the center of the tray, and a box-like container at the top. The tray has a slightly raised and uneven edge and appears to be made of metal, depicted in shades of gray and brown with patches of reddish rust. The vertical support features a looped handle positioned midway up its length, with the cylindrical form shaded in similar metallic tones. The top section is a rectangular, box-like component with an angled front, a small cylindrical protrusion at one end, and four rectangular tabs along the top. The entire composition uses realistic shading and detail, emphasizing the metallic texture and the effects of oxidation on the surface. The object is drawn on a plain, light beige background, with no additional decoration or objects present.
title: Whale Oil Lamp
